output.name: Streakly
output.description: Streakly is a habit tracker that lets you repair missed days and focus on weekly targets — not unbroken chains. No shame, no social feed, just progress. 41% of beta users still tracking at day 30. {APP_URL}
output.first_comment: Hey Product Hunt! I'm the maker of Streakly — a habit tracker built for real life, not perfect behavior. After seeing friends (and myself!) quit habit apps the moment we missed a day, I wanted to build something that forgives. Streakly lets you repair a missed day by doubling up within the week, scores habits against weekly targets, and keeps everything private on-device. We're coming out of a 800-person TestFlight beta where 41% were still tracking at day 30 and we got a 4.8-star average. No accounts, no social feed, no guilt — just gentle nudges and weekly wins. We're free during beta, with a $29/year tier planned. Would love your feedback on: 1) Whether the streak repair mechanic feels intuitive, 2) What you'd want in a premium tier, and 3) How we could better support the 'I keep restarting' crowd.
